text_block_list.name: C.B. & Ace
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaahhh—!! Daaaaaaaaaaaahhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was quite a race to watch! All that 
fighting spirit clashing together...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Katsuragi Ace! You've gotten so 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... gh!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah... damn it! So frustrating!!

Deafening cheers, thunderous applause. 
Tearing through the bustling racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOO---!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Damn it, dammit all!! Screw this--!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna! I'm gonna get so much 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even if everyone back home says I'll lose! 
Even if the pundits say I'll lose!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even if God says I'll lose, I'm gonna get 
strong enough to win anyway!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll shut destiny right up! That's the 
Katsuragi Ace I want to be—!!

Turning on her heel, she dashed into the 
underground passage. Many passionate gazes 
watched Katsuragi Ace's back as she 
departed.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha! Talk about déjà vu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Silencing destiny, huh? I like it, that's 
just like you."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'll be me. You be you...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That is what racing is all about...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should we do for the next 
race?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
GⅠ races really are the best. There's a 
feeling there you just can't get anywhere 
else.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It almost makes me feel sorry that you're 
not an Umamusume. Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Jokes aside... do you have any 
suggestions?

Speaking of GⅠ races held after the 
summer, the Tenno Sho (Autumn) comes to 
mind.

Katsuragi Ace, who could be called her 
worthy rival, will likely run as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, nice. Then it's settled!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's what I liked about it too. I 
figured if Ace is in, it's gotta be good.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad we see eye to eye. Otherwise, I 
would've had to persuade you."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You felt it too, didn't you? Ace was at 
her absolute best today.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Which means the next ace will be even more 
amazing. Even greater excitement than 
today is waiting for us on the turf...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can't wait! The Twinkle Series is 
the absolute best!

—Our next target race is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). A brilliant grand stage amidst 
falling autumn leaves!
